name: testimonials
description: Social proof section with member quotes. Masonry wall for high-density showcase, or featured trio for product pages.
intent: Make the visitor see themselves in the story. Real women, specific results, editorial photography. Builds trust between hero and pricing.
whenToUse: Homepage (between programs grid and footer), product pages (just before pricing / apply section), about page (showing community impact).

fields.quote: The testimonial. 1-3 sentences for wall, 2-4 for featured.
fields.name: Member name. Use [MEMBER NAME] as placeholder if unconfirmed.
fields.title: Business name, role, or descriptor.
fields.photo: Portrait URL. Optional. Use placeholder if unconfirmed.
fields.program: Which program they're from (FFB, FFM, FRESH). Shows as small tag.
fields.featured: Boolean. Larger card in masonry layout.

variants.wall: 8-12 quotes in a masonry grid, mixed card sizes. Homepage.
variants.single: One hero quote with big portrait, editorial spread. Between sections for emphasis.

ffm.title: The room that builds you back.

avoid: Fabricated quotes. Always use [MEMBER NAME PLACEHOLDER] or [CHECK: real quote] markers until verified.
Stock photography of women who aren't real members. Use placeholder avatars or real photography only.
Quotes longer than 4 sentences — reads like a case study, not a testimonial. Break into a case study block if longer.
Rating stars. Tracy's brand is editorial, not e-commerce review.

a11y.contrast: Text against card background must hit 4.5:1
a11y.images: alt text describes the person, e.g., 'Sarah Thompson, FFB member'
